summary: Artifact-triggered memory writes are implemented narrowly: successful write/edit/apply_patch completions append entries, successful bash only appends when new artifacts are produced, and no-op bash does not write memory.
notes: The classifier surface is explicit and tool-name-based; there is no conversational-memory automation in v1.
Foreground bash artifact detection is based on git status delta in the current repo, which keeps the v1 trigger narrow and observable.
Runtime integration proves the append-only ledger and projection update happen after successful relevant tool completions.
XTUI evidence uses a deterministic terminal fixture that renders the runtime outcome on a live TUI surface without depending on a remote model provider.
